name: Haunting Presence

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

disable: DC 16 Religion check to exorcise the haunt, or light the Eternal Lantern (automatically disables these haunts)

items.name: Ghostly Menace
items.text:
Trigger A haunt encounter occurs

---
Effect Kugaptee's presence makes itself known in a frightening way—a sudden shriek of agony, an explosive burst of red butterflies, a momentarily overwhelming air of decay, or the like. A random PC takes 2d6+3 mental damage (DC 19 basic Will save save), and then the haunting presence vanishes, leaving behind nothing but mental scars and trauma.

text: Ghostly sounds or glimpses of apparitions move to startle or distract those who walk the streets.
